sections.title: Bog plant
sections.text: Scheuchzeria palustris is a perennial of Sphagnum bogs and other peat wetlands across cool parts of the Northern Hemisphere. It grows about 20–40 cm tall from a creeping rhizome.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its erect stems bear widely spaced, narrow, grass-like leaves with a small pore at each tip. Small greenish flowers form a short terminal cluster and develop into pointed, pod-like fruits; the plate shows these features.

sections.title: Food and caution
sections.text: The references consulted treat it as a wetland species and provide no established human food use or specific toxicity information.
